evals.prompt: cotesy tidy — the scope's CLAUDE.md references a script that was deleted last week, and the same convention is stated almost identically in both CLAUDE.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
evals.expected_output: Spawns the cotesy-groundskeeper agent with the scope path and shared reference path, which removes the stale entry (verified via Grep/Glob that the script no longer exists) and merges the duplicate convention into one target, with no new content added
expectations: Spawns the cotesy-groundskeeper agent, not cotesy-curator or cotesy-retirer
Does not read or reference .cotesy/wal.md at any point
Resulting plan only contains REMOVE/UPDATE/RELOCATE actions, never ADD
Stale entry referencing the deleted script is removed
Duplicate convention is merged into a single target, not left in both
Does not run git commit or git add

evals.prompt: cotesy tidy on a scope whose docs are already clean and well-organized
evals.expected_output: Spawns the groundskeeper, which audits everything, finds nothing to fix, and reports the docs are already clean without making any edits
expectations: Reports that the docs are already clean / no changes needed

evals.prompt: cotesy tidy in a folder with no .cotesy/ anywhere in its ancestry
evals.expected_output: Errors clearly that no .cotesy/ scope was found and suggests running cotesy:init, without spawning the groundskeeper agent
expectations: Does not spawn the cotesy-groundskeeper agent
Error message mentions no .cotesy/ scope was found
